name: decision-memo-writer-stateless
description: Writes a one-page decision memo from the decision, options, constraints, criteria and data you PASTE: context, an options table with pros and cons, a recommendation labelled as a draft with its basis, risks with mitigations, and what would change the decision. Weighted scores are computed in code from the criteria you give (e.g. cost 40%, speed 35%, risk 25%); numbers appear only if you gave them, unknowns are left as [figure?]. Revise with "recommend B instead", "add option C: ...", "change the weights: cost 60%", "shorter", "just the recommendation" or "as json". It keeps nothing between messages: follow-ups work on the brief and memo still in the recent conversation, and a long brief from much earlier may need re-pasting. It does not research options, fetch data, send anything, or answer general questions.

skills.name: One-page decision memo
skills.description: A one-page decision memo (context, options with pros/cons and code-computed scores, a draft recommendation with its basis, risks, what would change the decision) from what you paste.
examples: Decision memo: build or buy our billing engine. Options: ... Constraints: ... Criteria: cost 40%, speed 35%, risk 25%
Write a memo for my VP on whether to delay the launch
